questions.question:
The total surface area of a right circular cylinder with radius of the base 12 cm and height 72 cm is:

(take pi = 22/7 )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Total Surface Area involves the term 2 × π × r × (r + h).

Substituting the values: 2 × (22/7) × 12 × 84 ⇒ 2 × 22 × 12 × 12.

Check the unit digit of the product: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16 ⇒ Unit digit is 6.

Looking at the given options, only 6336 has a unit digit of 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6336 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• r = 12 cm 
• 
• 
• h = 72 cm 

**Given:**

Radius of the base of the cylinder (r) = 12 cm

Height of the cylinder (h) = 72 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder = 2 × π × r × (r + h)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × (12 + 72)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 12 × 84

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 22 × 12 × 12

⇒ Total Surface Area = 44 × 144

⇒ Total Surface Area = 6336 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 6336 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

CSA = 2 × π × r × h. This measures only the lateral curved surface, excluding the top and bottom circular bases.

Volume of Cylinder

Volume = π × r² × h. It defines the total 3D space or capacity enclosed by the cylinder.

Total Surface Area of a Cone

TSA = π × r × (r + l), where 'l' is the slant height. Slant height is calculated as l = √(r² + h²).

questions.question: ₹3,246 is divided among A, B, C and D in such a way that the shares of A and B, B and C, and C and D are in the ratios of 4 : 5, 4 : 5, and 6 : 7, respectively. The share of A (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Chain the ratios directly and equalize stepwise.

A:B = 4:5 and B:C = 4:5 ⇒ A:B:C = 16:20:25

Now match C:D = 6:7 with C = 25 ⇒ multiply by 6 ⇒ 150:175

Final ratio = 96:120:150:175

**∴ Answer = 576**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 3246 and ratios A:B = 4:5, B:C = 4:5, C:D = 6:7

**Formula used:**

Convert all ratios into a common ratio

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 4 : 5

⇒ B : C = 4 : 5

⇒ A : B : C = 16 : 20 : 25

⇒ C : D = 6 : 7

⇒ Make C same ⇒ 150 : 175

⇒ Final ratio = 96 : 120 : 150 : 175

⇒ Sum = 541

⇒ A's share = (96/541) × 3246 = 576

**∴ The correct answer is 576.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combining Ratios

If A:B and B:C are given, equalize B to combine ratios.

Proportional Distribution

Share = (individual ratio / total ratio) × total amount

Scaling Ratios

Ratios can be multiplied by a constant to match terms.

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 90, 94, 44, 97, 46, 72, 62, 44 and 54 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 70.

Deviations from 70 = +20, +24, −26, +27, −24, +2, −8, −26, −16.

Sum of deviations = 20 + 24 − 26 + 27 − 24 + 2 − 8 − 26 − 16 = −27

Net deviation per observation = −27 ÷ 9 = −3

Actual Mean = 70 − 3 = 67

**∴ The correct answer is 67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 90, 94, 44, 97, 46, 72, 62, 44, 54

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 Sum of 9 observations = 603 
• Divided equally into 9 parts Mean = 67 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 90 + 94 + 44 + 97 + 46 + 72 + 62 + 44 + 54

⇒ Sum = 603

⇒ Total number of observations = 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 603 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 67

**∴ The correct answer is 67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when items have different frequencies or weights: Mean = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ)

Combined Mean

Used to find the combined mean of two merged groups: Combined Mean = (n₁m₁ + n₂m₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Median and Mode

Median is the exact middle value of a sorted data set. Mode is the most frequently occurring value in the set.

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹70,000. He saves 26% of his income. If his income increases by 32% and expenditure increases by 45%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 70000, Savings = 26% ⇒ Expenditure = 74%

New Income = 70000 × 1.32 = 92400

New Expenditure = 70000 × 0.74 × 1.45 = 75110

New Savings = 92400 − 75110 = 17290

**∴ Decrease in savings = 18200 − 17290 = 910**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 70000, Savings = 26%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Savings = 26% of 70000 = 18200

⇒ Expenditure = 70000 − 18200 = 51800

⇒ New Income = 70000 × 1.32 = 92400

⇒ New Expenditure = 51800 × 1.45 = 75110

⇒ New Savings = 92400 − 75110 = 17290

⇒ Change = 17290 − 18200 = −910

**∴ The savings decrease by ₹910.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase Formula

New Value = Original × (1 + rate/100)

Savings Concept

Savings = Income − Expenditure

Key Insight

If expenditure rises faster than income, savings will decrease.

questions.question: {If } ( 8.5 div 0.25 + (26)/(3) div (1)/(3) ) { of } (3)/(50) = 0.01 { of } P, { then the value of } P { is}: 5479
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert divisions quickly:

8.5 ÷ 0.25 = 34 and (26/3) ÷ (1/3) = 26

Sum = 34 + 26 = 60

⇒ 60 × (3/50) = 3.6

**∴ 0.01P = 3.6 ⇒ P = 360**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(8.5 ÷ 0.25 + (26/3) ÷ (1/3)) of (3/50) = 0.01P

**Formula used:**

Division of fractions ⇒ a ÷ (b/c) = a × (c/b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8.5 ÷ 0.25 = 8.5 × 4 = 34

⇒ (26/3) ÷ (1/3) = (26/3) × 3 = 26

⇒ Sum = 34 + 26 = 60

⇒ 60 × (3/50) = 180/50 = 3.6

⇒ 0.01P = 3.6

⇒ P = 3.6 ÷ 0.01 = 360

**∴ The correct answer is 360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division by Decimal

Dividing by 0.25 is same as multiplying by 4

Fraction Division Rule

a ÷ (b/c) = a × (c/b)

Percentage Conversion

0.01 = 1/100, so multiply RHS accordingly

questions.question: In a right-angle triangle ABC, right angled at B, AB = 8 cm. A line AO is drawn which meets BC at O such that AO = OC = 10 cm. Find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Recognize the common Pythagorean triplet (6, 8, 10) in right-angled ΔABO.

Given AB = 8 cm and hypotenuse AO = 10 cm, the base BO is directly 6 cm.

Since OC = 10 cm, the total base of ΔABC is BC = BO + OC = 6 + 10 = 16 cm.

Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 16 × 8 = 64 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 64 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• 
 A B C O 8 cm 10 cm 
• 
• 
• 
• 6 cm 
• 10 cm 
• 
• 
• Total Base BC = 16 cm Area of ΔABC = 64 cm² 

**Given:**

Triangle ABC is right-angled at B.

Perpendicular side AB = 8 cm.

Line segment AO = 10 cm and OC = 10 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

Area of a Right-Angled Triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height

**Calculations:**

⇒ In right-angled ΔABO, applying the Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ AO² = AB² + BO²

⇒ 10² = 8² + BO²

⇒ 100 = 64 + BO²

⇒ BO² = 100 − 64 = 36

⇒ BO = √36 = 6 cm

⇒ Total base BC = BO + OC = 6 cm + 10 cm = 16 cm

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × Base × Height

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × BC × AB

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × 16 × 8 = 64 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 64 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is strictly equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².

Pythagorean Triplets

A set of three positive integers that perfectly satisfy the Pythagoras theorem. Common exam triplets include (3, 4, 5), (6, 8, 10), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17).

Area of Triangle

For a triangle with a known base length and perpendicular height directly dropping to it, the area is calculated using the standard formula: Area = 1/2 × Base × Height.

questions.question: The average age of a father and his daughter is 27 years. The ratio of their ages 4 years hence from now, will be 23 : 8. Find the daughter's present age (in years).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present sum of ages = 27 × 2 = 54 years.

Sum of ages after 4 years = 54 + 8 = 62 years.

Total ratio parts after 4 years = 23 + 8 = 31 parts.

31 parts = 62 years ⇒ 1 part = 2 years.

Daughter's present age = (8 parts × 2) − 4 = 12 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average present age of father and daughter = 27 years

Ratio of their ages 4 years hence = 23 : 8

 Ages 4 Years Hence Total Sum = 54 (Present) + 8 = 62 years Father (23 units) 8 units 
 Total 31 units = 62 years → 1 unit = 2 years Daughter's Present Age = (8 × 2) − 4 = 12 years 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of their present ages = 27 × 2 = 54 years

⇒ Let the present age of the father be F and the daughter be D.

⇒ F + D = 54

⇒ After 4 years, Father's age = F + 4 and Daughter's age = D + 4

⇒ (F + 4) / (D + 4) = 23 / 8

⇒ 8 × (F + 4) = 23 × (D + 4)

⇒ 8F + 32 = 23D + 92

⇒ 8F − 23D = 60

⇒ Substituting F = 54 − D into the equation:

⇒ 8 × (54 − D) − 23D = 60

⇒ 432 − 8D − 23D = 60

⇒ 31D = 432 − 60

⇒ 31D = 372

⇒ D = 372 ÷ 31 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Ages Over Time

If the sum of ages of n people is S, then their sum of ages after t years will be S + nt, because each person's age increases by t years independently.

Change in Average Age

If the present average age of a group is A, their average age after t years will exactly be A + t. The new total sum will naturally be n × (A + t).

Age Ratio Interpretation

When setting up linear equations from word problems, "t years hence" always requires adding t to the present age variables, while "t years ago" requires subtracting t from the present age variables before applying any ratio comparison.

questions.question: A dealer purchased a microwave for ₹57,000. He allows a discount of 64% on its marked price and still gains 38%. Find the marked price of the microwave.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price = 57000

Gain 38% ⇒ Selling Price = 57000 × 1.38 = 78660

Discount = 64% ⇒ SP = 36% of MP

⇒ MP = 78660 ÷ 0.36

**∴ MP = 218500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP = 57000, Gain = 38%, Discount = 64%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Gain%) and SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 57000 × 1.38 = 78660

⇒ SP = 36% of MP

⇒ 0.36 × MP = 78660

⇒ MP = 78660 ÷ 0.36 = 218500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹218500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + profit/100)

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − discount/100)

Key Insight

Link SP from both profit and discount equations to find MP

questions.question: The sum of two consecutive numbers is 51. What are the numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of two consecutive integers is exactly halfway between them.

Average = Sum ÷ 2 = 51 ÷ 2 = 25.5

The consecutive integers immediately below and above 25.5 are 25 and 26.

**∴ The correct answer is 25, 26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of two consecutive numbers is 51.

**Formula Used:**

Let the two consecutive integers be x and (x + 1).

**Calculations:**

⇒ x + (x + 1) = 51

⇒ 2x + 1 = 51

⇒ 2x = 51 − 1

⇒ 2x = 50

⇒ x = 50 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 25

The first number is 25.

⇒ The second number = x + 1 = 25 + 1 = 26.

**∴ The correct answer is 25, 26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Integers

Numbers that follow each other continuously in order from smallest to largest without any gaps. They can be represented algebraically as x, x + 1, x + 2, etc.

Consecutive Even or Odd Integers

The difference between consecutive even or consecutive odd integers is always 2. They can be represented algebraically as x, x + 2, x + 4, etc.

Average of Uniform Sequences

The average of any uniformly spaced sequence (such as consecutive integers) is exactly equal to its middle value, or the sum of the first and last terms divided by 2.

questions.question: If x² + (1)/(x²) = 47 , then a possible value of (x + (1)/(x)) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then the positive value of x + 1/x = √(k + 2).

Given k = 47.

⇒ x + 1/x = √(47 + 2)

⇒ x + 1/x = √49 = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x² + 1/x² = 47

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

Let a = x and b = 1/x, then:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + (1/x)² + 2 × x × 1/x

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

Substitute the given value x² + 1/x² = 47:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 47 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 49

Taking the square root on both sides:

⇒ x + 1/x = ±7

Looking at the given options, the possible positive value is 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Subtraction

If x² + 1/x² = k, then the positive value of x − 1/x = √(k − 2).

Squares and Cubes relations

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a.

Higher Power Identity

If x + 1/x = a, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² − 2)² − 2.

questions.question: The fourth proportional to 12, a, and 6a is 50. What is the positive value of 'a'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a proportion, the product of the extremes is equal to the product of the means.

⇒ 12 × 50 = a × 6a

⇒ 600 = 6a²

⇒ a² = 100

⇒ a = 10 (taking the positive value)

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers 12, a, 6a, and 50 are in proportion.

**Formula Used:**

If four numbers are in proportion, x : y :: z : w

⇒ x / y = z / w

 Proportion Concept 12 : a :: 6a : 50 
 Product of Extremes 
 Product of Means 12 × 50 = a × 6a 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 12 / a = 6a / 50

⇒ 12 × 50 = a × 6a

⇒ 600 = 6a²

⇒ a² = 600 ÷ 6

⇒ a² = 100

⇒ a = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers x and y is given by the formula √(x × y).

Third Proportional

For two given numbers x and y, the third proportional z satisfies the relation x : y :: y : z, giving z = y² ÷ x.

Continued Proportion

Three non-zero numbers x, y, and z are said to be in continued proportion if the ratio x : y is equal to the ratio y : z.

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 20 cm, 51 cm, and 37 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 51 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter, s = (20 + 37 + 51) ÷ 2 = 54 cm

Area using Heron's formula = √(54 × 34 × 17 × 3) = 306 cm²

Area is also = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Altitude

⇒ 306 = (1 ÷ 2) × 51 × h

⇒ h = (306 × 2) ÷ 51 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sides of the triangle are a = 20 cm, b = 37 cm, and c = 51 cm.

We need to find the altitude corresponding to the side c = 51 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula for Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Where semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

Area of a triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × base × height

 
 
• 
 A B C D 20 cm 37 cm 51 cm h 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (20 + 37 + 51) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 108 ÷ 2 = 54 cm

⇒ Area = √[54 × (54 − 20) × (54 − 37) × (54 − 51)]

⇒ Area = √(54 × 34 × 17 × 3)

⇒ Area = √(9 × 6 × 2 × 17 × 17 × 3)

⇒ Area = √(9 × 36 × 17²)

⇒ Area = 3 × 6 × 17 = 306 cm²

Now, substitute the obtained Area into the base and altitude area formula:

⇒ 306 = (1 ÷ 2) × 51 × h

⇒ 612 = 51 × h

⇒ h = 612 ÷ 51 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of a scalene triangle when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)].

Inradius (r) and Circumradius (R)

The radius of the incircle is r = Area ÷ s. The radius of the circumcircle is R = (a × b × c) ÷ (4 × Area).

Altitude of a Triangle

The perpendicular segment from a vertex to the line containing the opposite side. The three altitudes intersect at a single point called the orthocenter.

questions.question: Two cars start from the same point and travel in opposite directions. If one car travels at 60 km/hr and the other at 75 km/hr, how far apart will they be after 3 hours?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds.

Relative speed = 60 + 75 = 135 km/hr

Distance covered in 3 hours = Relative speed × Time

Distance = 135 × 3 = 405 km

**∴ The correct answer is 405 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Car 1 (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Speed of Car 2 (S₂) = 75 km/hr

Time (t) = 3 hours

**Formula Used:**

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 6 and 3 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?

Total combined efficiency = (6 ÷ 2) + (6 ÷ 6) + (6 ÷ 3) = 3 + 1 + 2 = 6 units/day.

Time required for the normal work = 6 ÷ 6 = 1 day.

Time required for thrice the work = 1 × 3 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 2 days

Time taken by B = 6 days

Time taken by C = 3 days

Total Work = LCM of individual days taken

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Time Taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work required for thrice the original piece of work = 6 × 3 = 18 units

⇒ Time taken by A, B and C working together = 18 ÷ 6 = 3 days

Pipes & Cisterns

It operates exactly on the same principles as Time & Work. The key difference is that inlet pipes have a positive efficiency (filling), whereas outlet pipes or leaks have a negative efficiency (emptying).

Work & Wages

Total wages paid to workers are always distributed in the exact ratio of the overall work done by each person. If all persons work for the same number of days, their wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

For alternate working schedules, first find the total combined work done in one complete cycle (e.g., A works on Day 1, B works on Day 2 → 1 cycle = 2 days). Use this to find the total cycles required to reach near the total work, then calculate the remaining work for the next day.

questions.question: If mean is 35 and median is 33.5, then the value of mode is:6534
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a moderately skewed distribution, we can directly apply the empirical relation:

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

Mode = 3 × 33.5 − 2 × 35

Mode = 100.5 − 70 = 30.5

**∴ The correct answer is 30.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean = 35

Median = 33.5

**Formula Used:**

Karl Pearson's Empirical Formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

 Empirical Relation: Mode, Median & Mean 
• 
 
 Mode 30.5 Median 33.5 Mean 35 
 Diff = 3 
 Diff = 1.5 Ratio of Distances (Mode to Median) : (Median to Mean) = 2 : 1 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mode = 3 × 33.5 − 2 × 35

⇒ Mode = 100.5 − 70

⇒ Mode = 30.5

**∴ The correct answer is 30.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the difference between the mean and the mode is three times the difference between the mean and the median: Mean − Mode = 3 × (Mean − Median).

Positively Skewed Distribution

When a distribution has a long tail extending to the right, the values follow the relationship: Mean > Median > Mode. In this question, 35 > 33.5 > 30.5, confirming it is positively skewed.

Negatively Skewed Distribution

When a distribution has a long tail extending to the left, the values generally follow the relationship: Mean < Median < Mode.

Symmetric Distribution

In a perfectly normal and balanced distribution, the values overlap precisely, leading to: Mean = Median = Mode.

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 32 minutes and pipe B can empty it in 48 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together, after how many minutes should pipe B be closed, so that the tank is filled in 60 minutes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of the tank = LCM of 32 and 48 = 96 units.

Efficiency of A = 96 ÷ 32 = +3 units/min, Efficiency of B = 96 ÷ 48 = −2 units/min.

Pipe A runs continuously for the full 60 minutes, filling 3 × 60 = 180 units.

Excess water that must be emptied by B = 180 − 96 = 84 units.

Time for which pipe B must operate = 84 ÷ 2 = 42 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A to fill the tank = 32 minutes.

Time taken by Pipe B to empty the tank = 48 minutes.

Total time to fill the tank = 60 minutes.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculations:**

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Time (minutes)**
 **Total Work (units)**
 **Efficiency (units/min)**
 
 

 Pipe A
 32
 96
 +3
 
 

 Pipe B
 48
 −2
 
 

⇒ Let Pipe B be closed after x minutes.

⇒ Since the tank is filled exactly in 60 minutes, Pipe A operates for the entire 60 minutes.

⇒ Total work done by Pipe A + Total work done by Pipe B = Tank Capacity

⇒ (3 × 60) + (−2 × x) = 96

⇒ 180 − 2x = 96

⇒ 2x = 180 − 96

⇒ 2x = 84

⇒ x = 42

⇒ Pipe B was kept open for 42 minutes before closing.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Basics

A pipe that fills the tank has a positive efficiency, while a pipe that empties it (a leak) has a negative efficiency. If an inlet fills in x hours and an outlet empties in y hours, the net work completed in 1 hour is (1/x − 1/y).

Total Work Concept

Total capacity of the cistern is typically assumed as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the time taken by all individual pipes. This converts the fractional work into whole numbers, making calculations easier and faster.

Alternating Pipes

When pipes operate alternately, treat one complete cycle (e.g., 2 minutes) as a single unit of work. Always be careful in the final cycle, as the tank may get fully filled by the positive pipe before the negative pipe opens again.

questions.question: A camp has provisions for 55 persons for 14 days. In how many days will the same provisions finish off, if the strength of the camp is increased to 70 persons?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total provisions remain constant, so we can directly apply the inverse proportion relation M₁D₁ = M₂D₂.

⇒ 55 × 14 = 70 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 770 ÷ 70 = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial strength of the camp (M₁) = 55 persons

Initial number of days provisions last (D₁) = 14 days

New strength of the camp (M₂) = 70 persons

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

 Scenario 1 55 Persons, 14 Days Scenario 2 70 Persons, D Days 
• 
• 
• 55 × 14 = 70 × D 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total provisions required = 55 × 14 = 770 man-days

⇒ Let the provisions last for D₂ days for the 70 persons.

⇒ 70 × D₂ = 770

⇒ D₂ = 770 ÷ 70

⇒ D₂ = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

For constant work or fixed quantity of provisions, the relationship is M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂, where M is the number of persons, D is days, and H is hours per day.

Inverse Proportion

When the number of consumers increases, the time for which a given quantity of provision lasts decreases proportionally. Thus, Men × Days = Constant Value.

Provisions After Some Days

If after 'x' days some people leave or join the camp, the equation becomes M₁ × (D₁ − x) = M₂ × Dₙₑw applied strictly to the remaining provisions.

questions.question: A ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground when placed against a wall. If the foot of the ladder is 2 m away from the wall, the length of the ladder is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a right-angled triangle with angles 30°, 60°, and 90°, the side lengths are always in the ratio 1 : √3 : 2.

The side adjacent to the 60° angle (base) corresponds to 1 ratio part.

The hypotenuse (the ladder) corresponds to the longest side, which is 2 ratio parts.

Given that the base distance is 2 m (1 part), the hypotenuse will be exactly double this length.

Length of the ladder = 2 × Base = 2 × 2 = 4 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of the foot of the ladder from the wall (Base) = 2 m

Angle made by the ladder with the ground (θ) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

cos(θ) = Base ÷ Hypotenuse

 
 
 
 60° 
• 
• 2 m Wall Ladder (L) A B C 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the length of the ladder (Hypotenuse AC) be L.

⇒ In the right-angled ΔABC formed by the wall, ground, and ladder:

⇒ cos(60°) = BC ÷ AC

⇒ 1/2 = 2 ÷ L

⇒ L = 2 × 2

⇒ L = 4 m

**∴ The correct answer is 4 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios (SOH CAH TOA)

In a right-angled triangle: sin(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Hypotenuse, cos(θ) = Base ÷ Hypotenuse, and tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base.

Standard Trigonometric Values

Key values to remember for heights and distance: sin(30°) = 1/2, cos(30°) = √3/2. For 60° angles, sin(60°) = √3/2, cos(60°) = 1/2, and tan(60°) = √3.

Angle of Elevation and Depression

The angle of elevation is formed when observing an object above the horizontal line of sight, while the angle of depression is formed when looking downwards from a height.

questions.question: If 60% of 20% of 2/6 of a number is 343, find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given percentages and fractions to their simplest ratio forms: 60% = 3/5, 20% = 1/5, and 2/6 = 1/3.

Multiply these equivalent fractions together to find the combined factor.

Combined fraction = 3/5 × 1/5 × 1/3 = 1/25.

Since 1/25 of the required number is given as 343, we simply multiply 343 by 25.

Number = 343 × 25 = 8575.

**∴ The correct answer is 8575.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

60% of 20% of 2/6 of a number = 343

**Calculation:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ (60 / 100) × (20 / 100) × (2 / 6) × x = 343

⇒ (3 / 5) × (1 / 5) × (1 / 3) × x = 343

⇒ [ (3 × 1 × 1) / (5 × 5 × 3) ] × x = 343

⇒ (3 / 75) × x = 343

⇒ (1 / 25) × x = 343

⇒ x = 343 × 25

⇒ x = 8575

**∴ The correct answer is 8575.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Converting standard percentages to their lowest fractional terms drastically speeds up calculation steps. For example, 20% = 1/5, 40% = 2/5, 60% = 3/5, 80% = 4/5, and 25% = 1/4.

BODMAS Rule

When simplifying arithmetic expressions, always follow BODMAS: Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction. The word 'of' signifies multiplication but takes precedence over regular division and multiplication.

Fast Multiplication Trick for 25

To multiply any given number by 25 quickly, simply multiply the number by 100 and then divide by 4. Example: 343 × 25 = 34300 ÷ 4 = 8575.
